description: This Java class defines a REST controller named HelloController that provides several endpoints: a welcome message at '/', documentation redirect at '/docs', health check at '/health', and application info at '/api/info'. It uses Spring Boot annotations for request mappings and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic endpoints for a Spring Boot application.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message at the root endpoint '/'

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to Swagger UI documentation, preserving original request scheme, host, and port

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns the application's health status at '/health'
